title: Let it “just flow”? Capricorn can’t.
caption: "Let's see where it goes" only works for so long, and Capricorn has a spreadsheet for it. Tell them you like where this is heading and the pace you'd like, then ask for theirs. Clarity feels safe to an earth sign.
